evals.prompt: Implement an iterative graph depth-first search (DFS) traversal function to discover reachable nodes from a start node, along with a GraphNode domain model.
evals.expected_output: A Python module containing a GraphNode dataclass with __slots__, an iterative DFS implementation with hard loop bounds, and no recursive calls.
assertions: The graph node domain model uses @dataclass(slots=True) or explicit __slots__
The DFS algorithm is implemented iteratively using an explicit stack
The algorithm contains zero recursive function calls
The while loop has a hard maximum iteration bound to prevent infinite loops
All functions include strict Python type annotations

evals.prompt: Implement a payload parser that validates untrusted external dictionary input into a typed UserConfig dataclass, with property-based tests.
evals.expected_output: A Python module with TypeGuard boundary validation, domain exception raising, and a Hypothesis test suite.
assertions: Uses typing.TypeGuard to validate raw dictionary structure at boundary
Raises specific domain exceptions on invalid input rather than generic Exception
Includes a test suite using hypothesis with strategies
